```{r}
library(ftsa)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("Netrokona.csv")
```

```{r}
y_mat <- as.matrix(df)

colnames(y_mat) <- as.character(2015:2024)

x <- 1:nrow(y_mat)        # Months (1–12)
time <- 1:ncol(y_mat)     # Years (10)
```

```{r}
fts_data <- fts(
  x = x,
  y = y_mat,
  xname = "Month",
  yname = "Water Table Depth"
)
```

```{r}
fit <- ftsm(fts_data, order = 3, method = 'rapca')
```

```{r}
fit$varprop
```

```{r}
fc <- forecast(fit, h = 6, method = 'arfima')
```

```{r}
fc$mean$y
```

```{r}
plot(fit$coeff, type = "l", main = "Principal Component Scores")
```

```{r}
plot(fc, "components")
```

```{r,fig.width=10}
plot(
  fts_data,
  col = gray(0.8),
  xlab = "Month",
  ylab = "Water Table Depth (m)"
)

# Add forecast
plot(fc, add = TRUE)

# Add legend
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("2025", "2030"),
  col = c("red", "blue"),
  lty = 1)
```
